preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.
The number of queries k is within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query pair (xi, yi) consists of distinct valid vertex indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices.
The input graph is guaranteed to be a vertex cactus (each vertex belongs to at most one simple cycle).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly k lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 1000000007 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer modulo 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: all(count_simple_paths(n, edges, queries[i][0], queries[i][1]) % 1000000007 == int(output_lines[i]) for i in range(k))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th output line equals the number of distinct simple paths between xi and yi modulo 1000000007.
